peer_paragraphs.s_mobile: Mobile learning applications have become a common tool in Philippine senior high schools, allowing students to review lessons outside the classroom and at their own pace. Teachers report that learners who use these applications complete more practice exercises each week.
peer_paragraphs.s_climate: Rising sea levels threaten coastal barangays in the Visayas, where many families depend on fishing for their livelihood. Local governments have started relocating households away from the shoreline, but the cost of new housing remains a major obstacle for poor communities.
peer_paragraphs.s_method: The researchers used a descriptive-correlational design and gathered data through a researcher-made questionnaire validated by three experts. The questionnaire was administered to one hundred twenty respondents selected through stratified random sampling.
peer_paragraphs.s_sleep: Insufficient sleep among college students is associated with lower academic performance, poorer concentration during lectures, and higher levels of stress. Students who sleep fewer than six hours a night tend to submit assignments late and score lower on examinations.
peer_paragraphs.s_ai: Artificial intelligence tools can help writers by detecting grammatical errors and suggesting clearer sentence structures. However, overreliance on these tools may weaken a student's own ability to revise and edit their work critically.
peer_paragraphs.s_water: Access to clean drinking water remains limited in many upland municipalities, forcing residents to collect water from springs and rivers that are often contaminated. Waterborne diseases such as diarrhea and typhoid are therefore more common in these areas than in the lowlands.
peer_paragraphs.s_purpose: This study aims to determine the effect of peer tutoring on the mathematics achievement of grade nine students in a public high school in Cebu City during the school year 2023 to 2024.

acknowledgement: The researchers would like to express their sincere gratitude to their adviser, their families and friends, and to the Almighty God for the strength and wisdom to finish this study.
reference_entry: Santos, M. R., and Cruz, L. P. (2021). Mobile learning in Philippine senior high schools: A descriptive study. Journal of Educational Technology, 14(2), 45-61.
